- `make test-unit` runs the module tests only (seconds). Use it for quick checks while you work; it does not replace
  `make test` before a push.

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
pythonpath = ["."]
.PHONY: test test-unit

VENV_PY = .venv/bin/python

# the full suite: module tests plus the e2e order replay (about 4 minutes)
test:
	$(VENV_PY) -m pytest tests/ -q

# module tests only (seconds) - for quick checks while you work
test-unit:
	$(VENV_PY) -m pytest tests/ -q --ignore=tests/e2e
# storefront

The order, checkout and invoice code behind the shop.

    python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate
    pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
    make test-unit    # module tests, seconds
    make test         # full suite incl. the e2e order replay, about 4 minutes

`main` deploys to production on push. See AGENTS.md before pushing.
